component.name: GitStream
component.summary: Desktop Git GUI for everyday workflows

description.p: GitStream is a desktop Git GUI focused on everyday Git workflows — commits, branches, push/pull and diff review — without blocking the UI or unnecessary complexity.

ul.li: Commit graph with branch/merge lane rendering and infinite scroll
Stage, unstage, discard and partial (line/hunk) staging
Unified and side-by-side diffs with synchronized scrolling
Branches, tags and stashes management with search
Fetch, pull and push with a non-blocking network layer
Sync Assistant for rejected pushes and safe force-with-lease
Merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert and conflict resolution
File history, blame, and repository statistics

screenshot.caption: Commit graph, branches and side-by-side diff

description.p: Settings timeout values persist; wider Statistics window fitting the yearly heatmap.
